data.title: Monero Is Closer to Its All-Time High Than Bitcoin Is. What Is a Privacy Coin Doing Right?
data.description: A privacy coin built for anonymity is outperforming Bitcoin against its own all-time high, and the reasons behind that resilience reveal something unexpected about who actually holds Monero and why they refuse to sell.
